Thanks for taking the time to file a bug report. The more specific you are, the faster we can reproduce and fix the issue.

If you believe you have found a **security vulnerability**, do not file a public issue. See [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) and email [support@agentlabs.cc](mailto:support@agentlabs.cc) instead.

## App version

Visible in the app's Settings screen.

## opencode server version

Run `opencode --version` on the machine where the server runs and paste the output.

## OS and version

E.g. Android 14, Android 15, iOS 17.4.

1.

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened, including any error messages shown in the app.

## Logs and screenshots

Crash logs, relevant app logs, or screenshots that show the issue. If you opted into crash reporting, the Sentry event ID (if available) also helps.
